words.def_en: A chronic liver disease marked by permanent scarring and damage to the liver.

words.def_en: A natural stimulant found in coffee, tea, and some other plants.

words.def_en: A substance formed from two or more elements chemically combined.

words.def_en: A localized physical condition where part of the body becomes red, swollen, and painful.

words.def_en: The act of eating, drinking, or using up a resource.

words.def_en: Not extreme or excessive; within reasonable limits.

words.def_en: Persisting for a long time or constantly recurring.

words.def_en: Producing good results or helpful effects.
